openings.claim: First-parent-only normalization stores inspectable V columns alongside every original quantity, unit and citation, replacing repeated conversions. Apply only U=5V; preserve duplicates and unmatched rows individually. This establishes neither revision authority nor replacement links.
openings.discriminator: Against pairwise spreadsheet comparison using the identical factor and conservative reporting rules, columns may reduce conversion mistakes or reconversion time. Both should recognize seven stipulated agreements; these cannot distinguish variants. Compare key-correct resolved-batch counts, unsupported definite claims, elapsed time and request counts. No conversion-error advantage, worse key correctness or new unsupported definite claims defeats benefit; no improvement is established.
openings.probe: Bounded workflow probe, not deployment: run both variants on both supplied copies, fifteen minutes each, sixty reviewer minutes total. Freeze twelve cited batch outcomes and complete row ledgers per run. Reconcile quantities only with unambiguous normalized support; otherwise show bounded disagreement. Never infer missing quantities from neighbors or perform second-parent replacement linking. List amendment/status ambiguities; request at most three named missing fields or records, retaining other gaps visibly. On disturbed records, keep the missing superseded-row reference and undefined status explicit without inventing quantities or meanings. Incomplete ledgers fail completion, rather than count as successful disagreement. Use the extra twenty minutes after freezing to open the sealed key and compare scores.
openings.uncertainty: Stipulated records, conversion table, spreadsheet/script, copies and key are assumed available; contents beyond supplied observations remain unknown. Inspection and traceable completion within allocated time are unproven; any missed completion defeats probe feasibility. Stop limits alone do not establish informative feasibility. Normalization cannot cure revision ambiguity, undefined statuses or limited requests; cross-row replacement equivalence remains unresolved.

lineage.reason: Retains causal relation, rival, complete comparison/defeat conditions, constraints, declared fit and resource uncertainties.

decision: Retain D1 for bounded comparison; claimed preservation is intent, with benefit and timing unmeasured.
